title: THE SAVOY MALE AND FEMALE COLLEGE
text:
you are manifesting in behalf of us old has-beens and relics of the past.

I feel, with a host of others, this idea of a reunion of the old ex-students of Savoy College has been a dream devoutly desired but as time passed and teachers and friends dropped out of the procession each year, it seemed that our wish could never be consummated. But, now that it seems an assured fact that we are to have it, I am sure we are looking forward to the time with fond anticipation. . . .

Two photographs of the General Reunion Committee and the guests are shown in this chapter, the first one at Mr. Gus W. Thomasson's in Dallas on June 5, 1938, and the final one at Mrs. J. B. May's home in Savoy on July 31, 1938.
